steps.title: The 3D view
steps.text: Left-drag to rotate, right-drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Give it a spin, then press Next.

steps.title: Pick a part
steps.text: Click any plate: in 3D, on the cutting sheet, or in this list. It lights up in all three places.

steps.title: The cutting sheet
steps.text: Each sheet is a 40 × 60 cm foamex board. Orange hatching marks 45° mitered edges. Arcs show corners that aren't 90°. Scroll to zoom, drag to move.

steps.title: Switching sheets
steps.text: Use ◀ ▶ or the dropdown to move between sheets when a model needs more than one board.

steps.title: Explode
steps.text: Drag this slider to pull the plates apart and see how they fit together.

steps.title: Measurements
steps.text: Shows the size of every plate. The ones in the middle of the view stay sharp, the rest fade. Use Text to resize them.

steps.title: Pre-vis angle
steps.text: Jumps back to the camera angle from the emvee's mockup. That's it: replay this anytime with Replay tutorial at the top.
